name: createDevice
intent: Register a newly installed airport device and assign its responsible staff contact.
the admin adds it to the system and assigns a responsible staff contact
pre: The supplied device identifier is not assigned to an existing device.
The supplied contact identifier identifies a registered staff member.
post: The new device has the supplied identifier.
The new device has the supplied name.
The new device has the supplied location.
The new device is assigned to the staff member identified by contactsid.
The new device is stored among the system's devices.
difficulty_basis: Creation with three initialized fields, repository insertion and a staff association; two separately evidenced guards.
scenarios: Assertions check the new device, supplied fields, staff contact, storage and true result.
Duplicate device identifier explains rejection; test also checks repository preservation.
Missing staff contact explains rejection; test also checks no device is stored.
description_audit: KEEP + NORMALIZE. Preserve creation and contact assignment. Do not promote the final searchability/consistency sentence into an untested independent obligation or infer an admin-authorization guard.
reference_audit: Local encoded reference supplies the omitted true result and repository membership. All text is copied verbatim only into the hidden reference field.
effects_audit: Creation, each field, association, repository membership and return are separately represented. No deletion, cascading action or extra uniqueness rule added.
